svg.title: Where the pages of the website come from
svg.desc: The Markdown files in docs/ become the pages of the website, among them a page for each feature, and read the same on GitHub; the README keeps a line and a link for each. The hook of the website makes every comment of What reporters see from the functions and texts of issue_assistant.py, and the tables of the inputs and outputs on the Reference from action.yml. Every page gets a description of its own, from its front matter or its first paragraph.
